title: ee.source_authority.snapshot.v1
description: Deterministic, redaction-safe source-authority snapshot consumed by claim gates and unsafe-claim planners. Every coordination source is represented independently with status, freshness, command budget, timeout, exit class, partial-data availability, and repair guidance, so consumers can fail closed on precise per-source evidence instead of collapsing distinct failure classes into candidate_not_found.

x-ee-status.notes: Contract schema from bd-3w4pv.1. The read-only work-packet collector projection that emits this snapshot lands under bd-3w4pv.2; claim-gate and unsafe-plan integration lands under bd-3w4pv.4.

snapshotId.description: Stable snapshot identifier suitable for support bundles and Agent Mail summaries (for example sas-<blake3-16>). Never derived from raw query text or secrets.

workspaceLabel.description: Repo-relative or symbolic workspace label. Host-private absolute paths are forbidden by the redaction contract.

redactionStatus.description: The snapshot keeps source states, counts, budgets, exit classes, evidence ids, hashes, and repair guidance. It omits raw mail bodies, raw memory bodies, host-private absolute paths, raw command argv, and environment dumps.

ordering.description: Deterministic ordering contract. Producers must sort before writing; consumers may verify but must not re-sort differently.

sources.description: One record per consulted source, sorted by sourceKind ascending. A source that was not consulted at all must still appear with state=unavailable and statusDetail explaining why (for example skipped_by_flag), so absence of a record is never ambiguous.

candidateEvidence.description: Present when the snapshot was taken for a specific claim candidate; null for candidate-independent posture snapshots.

provenanceHash.description: Hash over the canonical serialized snapshot body, usable as a dedup and replay key.

producer.description: Optional ee.producer.metadata.v1 projection identifying the producing surface.

sourceState.description: Source-state taxonomy. ready: live read succeeded and is authoritative. degraded_read_only: source answered but must not authorize mutation (for example Agent Mail durabilityState=corrupt with green transport). unavailable: source absent, unreachable, or skipped; no evidence captured. timed_out: command or transport budget exhausted before an answer; MUST NOT be collapsed into unavailable or candidate absence. stale_fallback: live read failed but a bounded stale-safe snapshot or cache answered; evidence is advisory. corrupt_recovery: store is present but integrity-failed or mid-recovery; reads are non-authoritative until repair. contradicted: this source's evidence conflicts with another source and the contradiction is unresolved.

sourceKind.description: actionable_queue is the safe claimable-leaf queue (`scripts/br_retry.sh actionable --json`, bd-3w4pv.7): open, unassigned, non-epic rows served through the transient-read retry guard. It is modeled separately from the broader advisory beads (raw `br ready`) and bv (`bv --robot-next`) views so claim gates can explain which candidate source was authoritative, advisory, stale, absent, timed out, or contradictory. Records with this kind carry the actionableQueue extension block.

authoritative.description: True only when state=ready and no unresolved contradiction names this source. Consumers must fail closed when a decision requires a source whose authoritative=false.

capturedAt.description: Null when no evidence was captured (state=unavailable or timed_out with no fallback).

partialData.description: Distinguishes a complete answer from a partial one (for example Beads answered ready-work rows but the comments lookup timed out).

command.description: A repair command template with placeholder arguments (for example 'ee index rebuild --workspace .'). Raw captured argv from failed invocations is forbidden; reference it by evidenceId instead.

evidenceId.description: Stable id linking this record to durable evidence (a verification run, a support-bundle entry, or an Agent Mail summary). Deterministic for identical inputs.

statusDetail.description: Bounded human-readable detail. Must not contain raw mail bodies, memory bodies, host-private absolute paths, or captured argv.

actionableQueue.description: Required extension block for sourceKind=actionable_queue records; absent for every other source kind. Per-source budget, timeout, and exit semantics stay on the shared sourceRecord fields (budget, exit, freshness, fallback).

bvRobotNext.description: Optional extension block for sourceKind=bv records. It pins the bd-ifoh3.1 liveness envelope for BV robot-next timeout, no-output, partial-analysis, and recommendation-unavailable states.

bvRobotNextEvidence.description: BV robot-next liveness envelope. Bounded counts and enum-like phase names only; no raw BV stdout, raw tracker rows, private paths, or environment dumps. Non-ready postures must suppress claim commands so BV remains advisory until Beads/actionable-queue evidence and the claim gate agree.

graphNodeCount.description: Known graph node count from BV or a stale-safe source; null when BV produced no parseable graph metadata.

graphEdgeCount.description: Known graph edge count from BV or a stale-safe source; null when BV produced no parseable graph metadata.

skippedPhases.description: Bounded graph-analysis phases skipped because of timeout, graph size, stale source, parse failure, or partial output.

recommendationState.description: available means BV produced a parseable recommendation. empty_queue means BV authoritatively found no recommendation. Every other value is degraded/advisory and must not be treated as candidate absence.

claimCommandSuppressed.description: Must be true for every non-ready or advisory posture. A false value is valid only when sourceRecord.state=ready and recommendationState=available; the claim gate still decides whether any mutating claim action may be shown.

fallbackCommand.description: Read-only fallback command template, such as bv --robot-insights --format json or scripts/br_retry.sh actionable --json. Null only when recommendationState=available.

actionableQueueEvidence.description: Actionable-queue evidence (bd-3w4pv.7) for the safe claimable-leaf queue command `scripts/br_retry.sh actionable --json`. Bounded ids and counts only: no row titles, no raw command stdout. Precedence for consumers: actionable presence is necessary but not sufficient for a claim; BV recommendations are advisory unless the id is in this queue AND the claim gate passes; raw `br ready` rows never override the queue — rows it excludes are reported through the filter contract and exclusion counts.

rowCount.description: Null when the queue produced no answer (state=unavailable or timed_out).

candidateIds.description: Bounded, sorted bead ids from the queue answer. Truncation is reported via truncatedCandidateCount; membership decisions must be made by the producer against the full set, never re-derived from this bounded list.

filterContract.description: Static contract of the queue command: only open, unassigned, non-epic rows pass; blocked, deferred, and in-progress rows are structurally excluded because the queue is built from `br ready`.

lookupOutcome.description: candidate_present: at least one authoritative source confirms the candidate. candidate_absent_confirmed: every authoritative source answered and none contains the candidate. candidate_known_non_actionable: a source such as Beads proves the id exists, but the safe actionable queue excludes it because it is blocked, assigned, deferred, in progress, an epic, dependency-blocked, or otherwise non-actionable. candidate_lookup_unavailable: the sources that could answer were unavailable. candidate_lookup_timed_out: the sources that could answer exhausted their budget; absence is NOT confirmed. candidate_stale_fallback_only: candidate identity may be known, but at least one required claimability source is available only through stale-safe fallback. candidate_contradicted: authoritative sources disagree about the candidate.

staleFallbackPresence.description: Records candidate presence in stale-safe fallback evidence separately from live presence, so 'present in stale-safe Beads but missing from the live packet' is representable without contradiction.

partialData.reason: the actionable-queue probe shares the live br read that timed out

repair.guidance: Retry the safe claimable-leaf queue once the flush settles; timeout is not absence.

sources.statusDetail: actionable queue timed out before answering; candidate absence is NOT confirmed

partialData.reason: br ready exhausted the retry budget during a concurrent JSONL flush

repair.guidance: Retry through the transient-read wrapper once the flush settles.

sources.statusDetail: live br ready timed out; stale-safe snapshot from 182s ago answered
selector admission probe selected a healthy worker

candidateEvidence.explanation: Live Beads timed out before the candidate row could be read; the stale-safe snapshot contains the candidate, so absence is not confirmed and the claim gate must fail closed instead of reporting candidate_not_found.

degraded.message: Beads live read exhausted its 4000ms budget; stale-safe fallback evidence is advisory only.
